title: A2A Message Provenance Token Claims
description: JWT claims for the message provenance token (typ: a2a-msg-provenance+jwt). sub is the sender's Agent Card URL — the agent's canonical identifier per A2A v1.0 (cards have no id field). Content is bound via domain-separated per-part digests over decoded content; the card version is pinned by card_digest over the section 8.4 signing payload (presence-processed, signatures excluded).

iss.description: Platform origin, e.g. https://flocker.md. Verifiers resolve keys only from this issuer's pinned JWKS.

sub.description: Sender Agent Card URL. Origin MUST match iss; the verifier fetches and validates this card.

aud.description: Recipient identifier (card URL, endpoint URL, or agreed name).

exp.description: Unix seconds expiry. Enforced in live mode; audit-mode verifiers validate the full chain without exp gating.

jti.description: Unique token id; live-mode replay-cache key, scoped per aud, inserted only after full verification.

card_digest.description: SHA-256 over JCS of the section 8.4 signing payload (presence-processed card minus signatures). Pins the exact card version endorsed at signing time.

role.description: The message's role, per the proto enum JSON form.

parts.description: Ordered per-part digests; count MUST equal the message's part count. Digest input is UTF8(JCS(header)) || 0x00 || content-bytes, where header is {src, mediaType?, filename?} — domain separation prevents cross-kind or relabeled reuse.

src.description: Which Part oneof member the digest covers.

value.description: b64url digest. Content bytes: text/url = exact UTF-8 code points (no unicode normalization); raw = strict RFC 4648 base64-decoded bytes; data = hardened-JCS bytes (I-JSON profile, duplicate keys rejected).

media.description: Declared media type of the primary payload.

schema.description: Schema URI the recipient should interpret structured parts under.
